rules.image_pass: north_delta_dci>=0.02 and south_delta_dci<0 and ns_contrast_dci>=0.08 and contrast_to_abs_full>=10

key_values.event_name: Saharan dust storm over the Atlantic Ocean

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric values and the conclusion label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mostly correct structure with missing fields or inconsistent rounding.

criteria.name: DCI formula
criteria.description: Applies the DCI formula and valid-pixel brightness filter correctly for full, northern, and southern regions.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for using the DCI formula but omitting or misapplying the brightness filter.

criteria.name: Regional image anchors
criteria.description: Computes north delta near 0.034708, south delta near -0.073720, full delta near -0.003583, and north-south contrast near 0.108428.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per correct image anchor, with 1 additional point for correct signs.

criteria.name: Threshold proof
criteria.description: Applies the threshold proof correctly, including the contrast-to-full ratio and pass state for the north-weighted image signal.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct qualitative pass state with incomplete arithmetic.

criteria.name: Length and precipitation checks
criteria.description: Uses the reported plume length and largest event-total precipitation cell maximum in the consistency test.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for only one of these anchors.

criteria.name: Concise computed interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the final computed consequence concise and does not assert measured aerosol concentration, surface damage, or realized impacts.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct label with one minor overstatement.

provenance.notes: All values are computed from local CSX-295 package files; no network access is used.
